note: The Arma 3 CfgMarkers type families and the CfgVehicles vehicleClass and unitClass tokens mapped to the NATO APP-6(C) class categories. Every row is sourced or derived and carries its source.

prefixes.name: b_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers BLUFOR family; the suffix selects the category

prefixes.name: o_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers OPFOR family; the suffix selects the category

prefixes.name: n_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers Independent family; the suffix selects the category

prefixes.name: c_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers Civilian family; the suffix selects the category

prefixes.name: hd_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers header and objective family; a point marker

prefixes.name: flag_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers national and faction flags; no function glyph

prefixes.name: Contact_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 Contact DLC draw shapes; no function glyph

prefixes.name: group_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers group-size family; no function glyph

prefixes.name: loc_
prefixes.source: Arma 3 CfgMarkers location family; a place marker

suffixes.name: mech_inf

suffixes.name: air
suffixes.source: Arma 3 generic air marker, drawn as a helicopter

suffixes.name: plane

suffixes.name: naval

suffixes.name: dot
